static_traits.name: Chen Yu
static_traits.family_status: Lives with mother, close relationship, but has not yet expressed feelings of worthlessness to Mother
static_traits.social_status: Reduced socializing due to Low sense of self-worth, Social interaction limited
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problem history; no psychotherapy received yet; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Fairly cooperative, clear expression, able to describe trigger situations and emotions; mood fairly stable (Neutral attitude)

basic_info.main_problem: I am struggling with feelings of worthlessness and hopelessness related to my stamp collection.
basic_info.core_demands: The realization that my feelings of worthlessness are affecting my motivation and overall well-being pushed me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Several months ago, after Chen Yu saw a report on 'high-value stamp collections' in a magazine, he compared his own collection with it, strongly feeling his collection would 'never be worth money', developing worthlessness and hopelessness. Since then, seeing his stamp collection triggers these emotions. He tried researching how to increase the collection's value as a 'remedy', but saw no results yet, gradually losing interest and motivation in the collecting hobby, affecting daily routines, self-care, and job-seeking motivation, and Reduced socializing due to low self-worth.

core_beliefs: My collection will never be worth a penny

special_situations.event: Seeing in a magazine a feature on someone else's 'high-value' stamp collection and comparing it with their own collection
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my collection does not reach those levels and values, it means I am not good enough, worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifying research into ways to increase the collection's value, constantly comparing and evaluating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My collection is not worth mentioning, I am not good either

special_situations.event: Whenever seeing or thinking about one's stamp collection
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no immediate appreciation or bright spots are visible, it equals having no value at all
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids viewing and organizing the collection, reducing involvement to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It will never be worth money, I am wasting time

special_situations.event: Trying to find how to increase the collection's value but seeing no results
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If efforts still yield no results, it proves I am overall incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-criticism; reduces attempts to avoid feelings of failure again

special_situations.event: Thinking about applying for jobs or preparing to send resumes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not good enough, applications will not succeed either, so better not to start
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will not be hired anyway

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, have one's value seen, and gain affirmation through interests and achievements
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and appearing 'worthless' after comparison, triggering shame and hopelessness
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being judged by avoiding attempts and reducing exposure
Controlling uncertainty with rational analysis and objective evidence, easing Anxiety

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges (others / media standards / the market)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites recalling and accepting positive evidence (such as a thing one accomplished)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing positive experiences as 'exceptions / not counting', to maintain the 'I am not good' schema
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying success in a flat tone, emphasizing chance or external causes, using phrasings like 'just luck / does not mean I am good' to negate positive evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When comparisons with others or market standards are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting one's self-critical experience as 'others will look down on / negate me'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: States things from others' perspectives such as 'they will all think...', avoiding expressing his own real needs and vulnerability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing suggestions for emotional exploration or behavioral change
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Distancing from shame and hopelessness by discussing objective aspects like 'market, evidence, value standards'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Turns to data and logical details, weakens emotional vocabulary, prolongs the topic in an analytical tone, reducing emotional contact.

manifestations: Believing one's stamp collection will 'never be worth money', thus doubting the meaning of the interest and investment
Experiencing worthlessness and hopelessness under comparison
Reduced socializing due to low self-worth
Close relationship with Mother yet not sharing true feelings and distress
outcomes: Emotional distress not externally regulated, negative cycle deepening

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Defines the value of self and the collection by the value standards given by magazines/the market
Taking others' standard that 'one must have high market value to be good' as the basis for self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-Reflection and excessive self-restriction/harshness, being overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Unwilling to discuss worthlessness with Mother, cautiously expressing vulnerable emotions
Avoiding interaction in social settings for fear of 'not being good enough'

exception_events.target_problem: In Learning/collaboration tasks, the client typically lowers participation or avoids due to Self-doubt, then further Self-denies afterward
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last semester led a Learning group with smooth progress; different from before, he took initiative and experienced Good results
exception_events.reason: Clue: clear task structure, more peer collaboration support; different approach: actively taking the organizing role; thus higher engagement and positive experience.

positive_force: Once had sustained commitment to an interest (stamp collecting)
Actively seeks ways to increase collection value, has problem-solving tendencies
Close relationship with Mother, potentially usable family support
Has had successful experiences (leading a study group)
Can recognize problems and actively seeks counseling help
negative_force: Internalizes external value standards as the basis for self-evaluation
Insufficient motivation for job-seeking and daily life, rising avoidance tendencies
Social withdrawal, not yet effectively using the existing support system

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding stamp-related activities with repeated 'collection has no value' negative self-statements, with low mood and hopelessness
antecedent: When seeing reports of high-value collections in magazines
Seeing or thinking about one's stamp collection
Thinking about value improvement with no results yet
target_behavior.core_reason: Equating self-worth with the collection's market value, forming the 'I am not good' belief through external comparison
target_behavior.function: Briefly avoiding shame and failure feelings, lowering Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced investment in interests and activities, Decreased motivation, impaired daily self-care, further Reinforcement of Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and not expressing emotions (including not discussing feelings with Mother)
antecedent: When thinking about interacting with others or sharing feelings
Situations where comparison or negation is feared
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing judgment, being seen as 'utterly worthless', preventing the experience of being negated through avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential negative evaluation and embarrassment, maintaining a surface sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, aggravated Loneliness and hopelessness, problem cycle continuing
